'File Name: mainnet/contracts/market/v0-4-market.clar -> Scope: High. LIQUIDATION GRACE IS RESOLVED PER ASSET AND THE ATTACKER PICKS THE ASSET. `is-liquidation-paused` returns true if `pause-liquidation` is set, if the `GLOBAL-LIQUIDATION-GRACE-ID` entry is live, or if the entry for the asset id passed to it is live. Determine exactly which asset id `liquidate` supplies, and show a borrower composing a multi-asset position so that the checked asset is the one under grace while the rest of the position is freely underwater. Impact: protocol insolvency, with the loss borne by suppliers.'
